bridges.statement: Christianity is a rational, evidence-responsive worldview that makes the best overall sense of reality.
God grounds an intelligible natural order and Christianity supplies an illuminating framework rather than a substitute for scientific causes.
The specifically Christian case rests on Jesus, whose life, death, and resurrection disclose God and make redemption possible.
Christian faith offers resources for suffering, responsible action, intellectual openness, and moral self-criticism.
Naturalistic atheism explains reality more rationally because it avoids unsupported supernatural additions.
Faith exceeds the evidence, while a designing intelligence compounds rather than explains complexity.
Christianity's distinctive historical and theological claims lack adequate support and fit suffering and providence poorly.
Religious faith can obstruct inquiry, intensify violence, and perpetuate inherited divisions through childhood inculcation.
